name: blockchain-qlearning-sim
description: Blockchain network simulation with Q-learning adaptive consensus

scripts.install:all: cd python-sim && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.dev: echo 'Run in separate terminals: npm run dev:server && npm run dev:web'
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build
scripts.test: cd python-sim && python -m pytest tests/ || echo 'No tests yet'
